about.hero.title: Understanding movement. Creating smarter spaces.
about.hero.lead: We are a research-driven project developing technology to analyse how people move and turn that data into useful insights for cities, events and public spaces.
about.hero.imageAlt: A sunny square in València with people walking; some figures are outlined in green boxes, as a sensor would mark them
about.approach.title: Technology with a purpose.
about.approach.lead: We combine sensing, data analysis and real-world experimentation to help design more efficient, comfortable and inclusive spaces.
about.approach.innovation.title: Innovation
about.approach.innovation.text: Exploring new ways to understand human mobility through LiDAR, IoT and data analytics, and open to smart city and govtech partnerships with city councils and public administrations.
about.approach.privacy.title: Privacy by design
about.approach.privacy.text: We develop privacy-conscious solutions that focus on patterns and collective behaviour, not individual identities.
about.approach.impact.title: Real-world impact
about.approach.impact.text: Turning complex measurements into actionable insights for cities, organisations and communities.

home.project.title: A project in development. An idea open to new possibilities.
home.project.question: Can we better understand how people move in order to make better decisions about the spaces we share?
home.project.paragraph1: We explore technologies such as LiDAR, IoT, edge computing and data analysis to build new people counting and crowd management tools. Our goal is to give smart city teams, public administrations and event organisers aggregated crowd data that helps them decide in time, without identifying anyone.
home.project.paragraph2: We are currently in research and development: building simulations, exploring applications and looking for real environments to validate our ideas.
home.project.paragraph3: We want to connect with people who share this interest: organisations that manage spaces and events, researchers, developers and technology companies.

research.questions.title: The questions that guide our research.
research.questions.detection.title: Can we accurately detect and predict crowd density and congestion in real time?
research.questions.detection.methodology: people detection and tracking, density estimation and short-term prediction.
research.questions.detection.experiment: simulation and real event data analysis.
research.questions.decisions.title: How can we turn spatial data into useful decisions for event operators and smart city teams?
research.questions.decisions.methodology: data fusion, crowd analytics and decision support models.
research.questions.decisions.experiment: prototype of real-time alerts and operational scenarios.
research.questions.deployment.title: How can we deploy reliable sensing systems in real event environments?
research.questions.deployment.methodolog: sensor placement, coverage analysis and performance evaluation (e.g. LiDAR sensors, IoT).
research.questions.deployment.experiment: field pilots to validate accuracy, robustness and operational feasibility.
research.featured.text: We analyse how LiDAR sensors can capture and characterise pedestrian movement in complex environments, to measure flow, density and trajectories.
